hook: Fifteen months building a better coding agent harness

beats.say: Mickey Petersen, author of Mastering Emacs, has released DreamCoder, a frontier coding harness with a tiling window manager that runs in the browser on all three desktop platforms.
He started in May 2025, expecting two or three months of work. It took fifteen months of UI and backend iterations and a beta test.
Petersen argues terminal coding agents are cramped and awkward for copying multi-line text, and that most GUI harnesses look the same: a sidebar and a chat pane.
